units.zh: 冊皇后儀
units.en: Ceremony for Conferring the Title of Empress
units.literal: Ceremony for Conferring the Title of Empress

units.zh: 天德二年十月九日，冊妃徒單氏為皇后。
units.en: On the ninth day of the tenth month of Tiande 2, Consort Tushan was formally invested as empress.
units.literal: On the ninth day of the tenth month of the second year of Tiande, the consort of the Tushan clan was invested as empress.

units.zh: 前一日，儀鸞司設座勤政殿，南向。
units.en: On the eve of the ceremony, the Ceremonial Escort Office arranged the imperial seat in the Qinzheng Hall, facing south.
units.literal: On the day before, the Ceremonial Escort Office set up the seat in the Qinzheng Hall, facing south.

units.zh: 設群臣次於朝堂。
units.en: Stations for the assembled officials were laid out in the court hall.
units.literal: They set up the officials' stations in the court hall.

units.zh: 大樂令展宮縣於殿庭，設協律郎舉麾位於樂縣西北，東向。
units.en: The Director of Grand Music set up the palace bell-chime ensemble in the courtyard and positioned the pitch officers' baton stations at the northwest corner of the ensemble, facing east.
units.literal: The Director of Grand Music deployed the palace bell-chime ensemble in the hall courtyard and set the pitch officers' baton-raising positions at the northwest of the music ensemble, facing east.

units.zh: 閣門設百官班位於庭，並如常朝之儀。
units.en: The Palace Gate Office marked out the officials' formation positions in the courtyard, following the usual court assembly protocol.
units.literal: The Palace Gate Office set the officials' formation positions in the courtyard, all according to the regular court assembly ceremony.

units.zh: 又設典儀位於班位之東北，贊者二人在南少卻，俱西向。
units.en: The master of ceremonies was posted northeast of the formation, with two announcers standing slightly to the south and back, all facing west.
units.literal: They also set the master of ceremonies' position to the northeast of the formation, with two announcers slightly withdrawn to the south, all facing west.

units.zh: 設冊使副位於殿門外之東，又設冊使副受命位於百官班前。
units.en: Positions were also assigned for the investiture envoy and deputy east of the hall gate, and for their station when receiving the imperial command in front of the officials' formation.
units.literal: They also set the investiture envoy's and deputy's positions to the east outside the hall gate, and also set their positions for receiving the command before the officials' formation.

units.zh: 又設冊寶幄次二於殿后東廂，俱南向。
units.en: Two canopy pavilions for the investiture book and seal were pitched in the eastern wing behind the hall, both facing south.
units.literal: They also set up two book-and-seal canopy pavilions in the eastern wing behind the hall, all facing south.

units.zh: 其日，諸衛勒所部，略列黃麾細仗於庭。
units.en: That day the guard commands led their units and posted a reduced formation of yellow-banner ceremonial regalia in the courtyard.
units.literal: On that day the guards of the various commands led their units and briefly arrayed the yellow-banner fine regalia in the courtyard.

units.zh: 符寶郎奉八寶置於左右。
units.en: The seal-and-treasure officers brought forward the eight imperial treasures and set them on either side.
units.literal: The seal-and-treasure officers presented the eight treasures and placed them to the left and right.

units.zh: 吏部侍郎奉冊，禮部侍郎奉寶匣，皆置於床，訖，出就門外班。
units.en: The Vice Minister of Personnel carried the investiture book and the Vice Minister of Rites the seal case; both were set on the presentation couch, after which the officers withdrew to join the formation outside the gate.
units.literal: The Vice Minister of Personnel presented the book, the Vice Minister of Rites presented the seal case; both were placed on the couch, and when finished they went out to take their places in the formation outside the gate.

units.zh: 大樂令、協律郎、樂工、典儀。
units.en: The Director of Grand Music, the pitch officers, the musicians, and the master of ceremonies.
units.literal: The Director of Grand Music, the pitch officers, the musicians, the master of ceremonies.

units.zh: 贊者各入就位。
units.en: Each announcer entered and took up position.
units.literal: The announcers each entered and took their positions.

units.zh: 群官等依時刻集朝堂，俱就次，各服朝服。
units.en: At the appointed hour the officials assembled in the court hall, took their assigned stations, and wore full court dress.
units.literal: The assembled officials gathered in the court hall at the appointed time, all took their stations, and each wore court dress.

units.zh: 侍中約刻板奏：「請中嚴。」
units.en: The Palace Attendant submitted on tablet: "We request that the inner court be secured."
units.literal: The Palace Attendant, having prepared the wooden memorial tablet, memorialized: "Request that the inner court be made strict."

units.zh: 通事舍人引群官入，就庭東西相向立，以北為上。
units.en: The protocol secretaries led the officials into the courtyard, where they stood facing one another east and west, with positions of honor to the north.
units.literal: The protocol secretaries led the officials in; they took their places in the courtyard standing facing east and west, with the north as the superior position.

units.zh: 又引冊使副立於東偏門，西向。
units.en: The envoy and deputy were also led to stand at the eastern side gate, facing west.
units.literal: They also led the investiture envoy and deputy to stand at the eastern side gate, facing west.

units.zh: 門下侍郎引主節，奉節立于殿下東廊橫街北。
units.en: The Vice Director of the Chancellery led forward the bearer of the imperial tally, who stood north of the cross-corridor in the eastern colonnade below the hall.
units.literal: The Vice Director of the Chancellery led the bearer of the main tally and presented the tally, standing with it north of the cross-street in the eastern corridor below the hall.

units.zh: 中書令、中書侍郎帥舉捧冊官，奉冊床立于節南。
units.en: The Director and Vice Director of the Secretariat led the book-bearers forward with the book couch, which was set south of the tally station.
units.literal: The Director of the Secretariat and the Vice Director of the Secretariat led the officials who would lift and present the book, presenting the book couch and standing south of the tally.

units.zh: 侍中、門下侍郎帥舉捧寶官，奉寶床立於冊床之南，俱西面。
units.en: The Palace Attendant and Vice Director of the Chancellery led the seal-bearers with the seal couch, placed south of the book couch, all facing west.
units.literal: The Palace Attendant and the Vice Director of the Chancellery led the officials who would lift and present the seal, presenting the seal couch and standing south of the book couch, all facing west.

units.zh: 侍中版奏：「外辦。」
units.en: The Palace Attendant reported on tablet: "The outer preparations are complete."
units.literal: The Palace Attendant memorialized on tablet: "The outer preparations are complete."

units.zh: 殿上索扇。
units.en: Attendants within the hall called for the ceremonial fans.
units.literal: The hall above requested the fans.

units.zh: 協律郎舉麾，宮縣作。
units.en: The pitch officers raised their batons, and the palace ensemble began to play.
units.literal: The pitch officers raised their batons, and the palace bell-chime ensemble began.

units.zh: 皇帝服通天冠、絳紗袍，出自東房，曲直華蓋、警蹕侍衛如常儀。
units.en: Wearing the Tongtian crown and crimson gauze robe, the emperor emerged from the eastern chamber with curved and straight canopies and the usual ceremonial escort.
units.literal: The emperor wore the Tongtian crown and crimson gauze robe, came forth from the eastern chamber, with curved and straight canopies and ceremonial escort according to regular protocol.

units.zh: 即座，南向坐，簾卷，樂止。
units.en: He took the throne facing south; the curtain was raised and the music stopped.
units.literal: He took his seat, sat facing south, the curtain was rolled up, and the music ceased.

units.zh: 通事舍人引冊使副入，宮縣作。
units.en: The protocol secretaries escorted the investiture envoy and deputy inside as the palace ensemble played again.
units.literal: The protocol secretaries led the investiture envoy and deputy in, and the palace bell-chime ensemble played.

units.zh: 使副就受命位，侍中、中書令、門下侍郎、中書侍郎、舉捧官依舊西面立，群臣合班，橫行北面，如常朝之儀，立定。
units.en: The envoy and deputy took their stations to receive the command, while the Palace Attendant, Secretariat director, Chancellery and Secretariat vice directors, and presentation officials remained facing west. The full court formed ranks, moved into position facing north as at a regular audience, and held formation.
units.literal: The envoy and deputy took their positions for receiving the command; the Palace Attendant, Director of the Secretariat, Vice Director of the Chancellery, Vice Director of the Secretariat, and the presentation officials still stood facing west; the assembled officials formed ranks and moved horizontally to face north, as in the regular court assembly ceremony, and stood in formation.

units.zh: 典儀曰：「再拜。」
units.en: The master of ceremonies called: "Bow twice."
units.literal: The master of ceremonies said: "Bow twice."

units.zh: 贊者承傳，班首已下群官在位者皆再拜。
units.en: The announcers repeated the command, and every official in formation from the lead rank downward bowed twice.
units.literal: The announcers transmitted the command, and all officials in position from the head of the formation down bowed twice.

units.zh: 班首問起居，又再拜。
units.en: The lead official offered greetings for the emperor's welfare, then bowed twice again.
units.literal: The head of the formation inquired after the emperor's well-being, and again bowed twice.

units.zh: 閣門官引攝侍中出班承制，降詣使副東北，西向稱：「有制。」
units.en: A Palace Gate officer led the acting Palace Attendant from the ranks to receive the edict, then stepped down toward the envoy and deputy's northeast position, faced west, and declared: "His Majesty has an edict."
units.literal: A Palace Gate official led the acting Palace Attendant out of the formation to receive the edict, descended and went to the northeast of the envoy and deputy, faced west, and announced: "There is an edict."

units.zh: 使副稍前，鞠躬再拜，攝侍中宣制曰：「命公等持節授後冊寶。」
units.en: The envoy and deputy stepped forward slightly, bowed low twice, and the acting Palace Attendant proclaimed: "You are commanded to take the imperial tally and confer the investiture book and seal upon the empress."
units.literal: The envoy and deputy advanced slightly, bowed with a bent body and bowed twice; the acting Palace Attendant proclaimed the edict: "We command you to take the tally and confer upon the empress the book and seal."

units.zh: 宣制訖，又俱再拜，侍中還班。
units.en: When the edict had been read, all bowed twice again together, and the Palace Attendant returned to the ranks.
units.literal: When the proclamation of the edict was finished, all again bowed twice together, and the Palace Attendant returned to the formation.

units.zh: 門下侍郎引主節詣冊使所，主節以節授門下侍郎、門下侍郎執節西向授太尉，太尉受付主節，主節立於使副之左右。
units.en: The Vice Director of the Chancellery led the tally-bearer to the envoy's station. The tally was passed to the vice director, who, facing west, presented it to the Grand Commandant. After receiving it, the Grand Commandant returned it to the tally-bearer, who took position on either side of the envoy and deputy.
units.literal: The Vice Director of the Chancellery led the bearer of the main tally to the investiture envoy's position; the bearer of the tally handed the tally to the Vice Director of the Chancellery; the Vice Director held the tally and, facing west, conferred it upon the Grand Commandant; the Grand Commandant received it and handed it back to the bearer of the tally; the bearer of the tally stood to the left and right of the envoy and deputy.

units.zh: 門下侍郎退還班位。
units.en: The Vice Director of the Chancellery withdrew to his place in the ranks.
units.literal: The Vice Director of the Chancellery withdrew and returned to the formation position.

units.zh: 中書侍郎引冊床，門下侍郎引寶床，立于冊使東北，西向，以次授與太尉，太尉皆捧受。
units.en: The Vice Director of the Secretariat brought forward the book couch and the Vice Director of the Chancellery the seal couch. Standing northeast of the envoy and facing west, they presented them in turn to the Grand Commandant, who received each with both hands.
units.literal: The Vice Director of the Secretariat led the book couch, the Vice Director of the Chancellery led the seal couch; they stood northeast of the investiture envoy, facing west, and in order conferred them upon the Grand Commandant, who received them all with both hands.

units.zh: 冊床置於北，寶床置於南。
units.en: The book couch was set to the north and the seal couch to the south.
units.literal: The book couch was placed to the north, the seal couch to the south.

units.zh: 侍中、中書令、禮儀使、舉捧冊寶官及舁床者，退於東西磚道之左右，相向立。
units.en: The Palace Attendant, Secretariat director, director of ceremonial protocol, book-and-seal bearers, and couch-bearers withdrew to either side of the eastern and western brick pathways and stood facing one another.
units.literal: The Palace Attendant, Director of the Secretariat, director of ceremonial protocol, the officials who would lift and present the book and seal, and those who would carry the couches withdrew to the left and right of the eastern and western brick pathways and stood facing one another.

units.zh: 門下侍郎、中書侍退還班位。
units.en: The Vice Directors of the Chancellery and Secretariat returned to their stations in the ranks.
units.literal: The Vice Director of the Chancellery and the Vice Director of the Secretariat withdrew and returned to their formation positions.

units.zh: 典儀曰：「再拜。」
units.en: The master of ceremonies called: "Bow twice."
units.literal: The master of ceremonies said: "Bow twice."

units.zh: 贊者承傳，群官在位者皆再拜，訖，分班東西相向立。
units.en: The announcers repeated the command, all officials bowed twice, then split into east-west formations facing one another.
units.literal: The announcers transmitted the command; all officials in position bowed twice, and when finished they divided into formations standing facing east and west.

units.zh: 捧舉舁冊寶床者進，冊床先行，讀冊官次之，寶床次行，讀寶官次之。
units.en: The bearers advanced with the book-and-seal couches: the book couch first, then the book reader, then the seal couch, then the seal reader.
units.literal: Those who would hold, lift, and carry the book-and-seal couches advanced; the book couch went first, the book-reading officer next, the seal couch went next, and the seal-reading officer after that.

units.zh: 舉舁官各分左右，通事舍人引冊使隨之以行，持節者前導。
units.en: The lifting and carrying officers divided to left and right while the protocol secretaries led the investiture envoy in procession, the tally-bearer going ahead as guide.
units.literal: The lifting and carrying officers each divided to left and right; the protocol secretaries led the investiture envoy to follow in procession; the tally-bearer went ahead as guide.

units.zh: 太尉初行，宮縣樂作，出殿門，樂止。
units.en: As the Grand Commandant set out, the palace ensemble played; music ceased once they passed through the hall gate.
units.literal: When the Grand Commandant first set out, the palace bell-chime ensemble played; when they exited the hall gate, the music ceased.

units.zh: 攝侍中出班升殿奏：「侍中臣言禮畢。」
units.en: The acting Palace Attendant left the ranks, ascended the hall, and reported: "This subject, the Palace Attendant, reports that the rites are complete."
units.literal: The acting Palace Attendant came out of the formation, ascended the hall, and memorialized: "Your subject the Palace Attendant reports that the ceremony is complete."

units.zh: 殿上索扇，簾降，宮縣作。
units.en: Attendants called for the ceremonial fans, the curtain was lowered, and the palace ensemble began again.
units.literal: The hall above requested the fans, the curtain was lowered, and the palace bell-chime ensemble played.

units.zh: 降座，入自東房，樂止。
units.en: The emperor left the throne and withdrew through the eastern chamber as the music stopped.
units.literal: He descended from the seat and entered by the eastern chamber; the music ceased.

units.zh: 通事舍人引群官在位者以次出。
units.en: The protocol secretaries led the assembled officials out in their proper order.
units.literal: The protocol secretaries led the officials in position out in order.

units.zh: 俟太尉、司徒複命，禮畢，還內。
units.en: They waited until the Grand Commandant and Minister of Education returned to report; once the rites were concluded, everyone withdrew to the inner precincts.
units.literal: They waited until the Grand Commandant and Minister of Education returned to report completion; when the ceremony was finished, they returned inside.

units.zh: 先是，有司預設太尉、司徒本品革車鹵簿於門外至殿門左右排列。
units.en: In advance, the responsible offices had posted the Grand Commandant's and Minister of Education's full ceremonial chariots and escort insignia, arranged from the outer gate to either side of the hall entrance.
units.literal: Beforehand, the relevant offices had pre-arranged the Grand Commandant's and Minister of Education's regulation leather chariots and insignia of their proper ranks outside the gate, arrayed to left and right from the outer gate to the hall gate.

units.zh: 俟使副出，鼓吹振作。
units.en: When the envoy and deputy emerged, the ceremonial wind and percussion ensemble struck up.
units.literal: When the envoy and deputy came out, the wind-and-percussion band began to play vigorously.

units.zh: 禮儀使、舉捧官、執節者並抬舁人，以冊寶少駐於泰和門，太尉、司徒及讀冊寶官暫歸幕次。
units.en: The director of ceremonial protocol, presentation officers, tally-bearer, and all bearers paused briefly at the Taihe Gate with the book and seal, while the Grand Commandant, Minister of Education, and the reading officers withdrew temporarily to their pavilions.
units.literal: The director of ceremonial protocol, the presentation officials, the tally-holder, and all the lifting and carrying personnel, with the book and seal, paused briefly at the Taihe Gate; the Grand Commandant, Minister of Education, and the book- and seal-reading officers temporarily returned to their pavilion stations.

units.zh: 內侍閣門引入泰和殿，俟至殿下位，鼓吹止。
units.en: Inner attendants and Palace Gate officers escorted the procession into the Taihe Hall; the wind-and-percussion music stopped when they reached the foot of the hall.
units.literal: The inner attendants and Palace Gate officers led them into the Taihe Hall; when they reached the position below the hall, the wind-and-percussion music ceased.

units.zh: 有司預供張，泰和殿設皇后座于扆前，殿上垂簾。
units.en: The responsible offices had prepared in advance: the empress's seat was set before the screen in the Taihe Hall, with a curtain hung across the upper hall.
units.literal: The relevant offices had made advance provisions; in the Taihe Hall they set the empress's seat before the screen, and a curtain was hung on the hall platform.

units.zh: 又設東西房於座之左右稍北。
units.en: Eastern and western side chambers were also arranged slightly north of the seat on either side.
units.literal: They also set up eastern and western chambers slightly north to the left and right of the seat.

units.zh: 又設受冊位於殿庭西階之南，東向。
units.en: A station for receiving the investiture was also marked south of the western steps in the courtyard, facing east.
units.literal: They also set the position for receiving the book south of the western steps of the hall courtyard, facing east.

units.zh: 又設內命婦次於殿之左右。
units.en: Stations were also assigned for inner consorts to the left and right of the hall.
units.literal: They also set the stations for inner consorts to the left and right of the hall.

units.zh: 大樂令設宮縣於庭，協律郎設舉麾位於殿上。
units.en: The Director of Grand Music set up the palace ensemble in the courtyard, and the pitch officers took their baton stations on the hall platform.
units.literal: The Director of Grand Music set up the palace bell-chime ensemble in the courtyard; the pitch officers set their baton-raising positions on the hall platform.

units.zh: 又設冊寶次於門外。
units.en: A pavilion for the book and seal was also set up outside the gate.
units.literal: They also set up the book-and-seal pavilion outside the gate.

units.zh: 又設行事官次於門左右。
units.en: Stations for the ritual officers were also laid out on either side of the gate.
units.literal: They also set the stations for the ritual officers to the left and right of the gate.

units.zh: 又設外命婦次於門之內。
units.en: Stations for outer consorts were also arranged inside the gate.
units.literal: They also set the stations for outer consorts inside the gate.

units.zh: 其日，諸衛於殿門外略設黃麾細仗。
units.en: That day the guard commands posted a reduced yellow-banner ceremonial guard outside the hall gate.
units.literal: On that day the guards briefly set up the yellow-banner fine regalia outside the hall gate.

units.zh: 有司設二步障於殿之西階。
units.en: The responsible offices set up two portable screens at the western steps.
units.literal: The relevant offices set up two portable screens at the western steps of the hall.

units.zh: 簾前設扇，左右各十。
units.en: Ceremonial fans were set before the curtain, ten on each side.
units.literal: Before the curtain they set fans, ten on the left and ten on the right.

units.zh: 紅傘一，在西階欄子外。
units.en: A single red ceremonial umbrella stood outside the western stair railing.
units.literal: One red umbrella, outside the railing of the western steps.

units.zh: 又設舉冊寶案位於使副之前，北向。
units.en: Presentation stations for the book-and-seal tables were also set before the envoy and deputy, facing north.
units.literal: They also set the positions for presenting the book-and-seal tables before the envoy and deputy, facing north.

units.zh: 又設宣徽使位於北廂，南向。
units.en: The Xuanhui Commissioner's station was placed in the northern wing, facing south.
units.literal: They also set the Xuanhui Commissioner's position in the northern wing, facing south.

units.zh: 司贊設內外命婦以下陪列位於殿庭磚道之左右，每等重行異位北向，內命婦在後。
units.en: The master of announcements arranged the accompanying ranks for inner and outer consorts and those of lower rank along the brick pathways on either side of the courtyard, each grade in separate rows facing north, with inner consorts behind the outer.
units.literal: The master of announcements set the accompanying formation positions for inner and outer consorts and those below them to the left and right of the brick pathways in the hall courtyard; each rank formed separate rows in distinct positions facing north, with inner consorts in the rear.

units.zh: 又設司贊位於東階東南，贊者二人在南少退，俱西向。
units.en: The master of announcements was also posted southeast of the eastern steps, with two announcers standing slightly south and back, all facing west.
units.literal: They also set the master of announcements' position southeast of the eastern steps; two announcers slightly withdrawn to the south, all facing west.

units.zh: 質明，執事官大樂令等各就位。
units.en: At dawn the officiating officers, including the Director of Grand Music, each took up position.
units.literal: At dawn, the officiating officers including the Director of Grand Music each took their positions.

units.zh: 皇后常服，乘龍飾肩輿，至泰和殿后閣，近仗導衛如常儀。
units.en: Wearing ordinary dress, the empress rode in a dragon-decorated shoulder palanquin to the rear pavilion of the Taihe Hall, escorted by her close guard in the usual manner.
units.literal: The empress wore ordinary dress, rode in a shoulder-borne palanquin ornamented with dragons, arrived at the rear pavilion of the Taihe Hall, with close guard escort according to regular protocol.

units.zh: 宣徽使奏：「中嚴。」
units.en: The Xuanhui Commissioner reported: "The inner court is now secured."
units.literal: The Xuanhui Commissioner memorialized: "The inner court is made strict."

units.zh: 冊使副入門，宮縣作，俟冊使庭中立，樂止。
units.en: The investiture envoy and deputy entered the gate to music from the palace ensemble, which ceased once the envoy had taken station in the center of the courtyard.
units.literal: The investiture envoy and deputy entered the gate; the palace bell-chime ensemble played; they waited until the investiture envoy stood in the center of the courtyard, then the music ceased.

units.zh: 冊在北，寶在南，使副立於床後。
units.en: The book stood to the north and the seal to the south, with the envoy and deputy behind the presentation couches.
units.literal: The book was to the north, the seal to the south; the envoy and deputy stood behind the couches.

units.zh: 禮儀使帥持節者立於前，舉捧冊寶官立於冊寶床左右，讀冊寶官各立於其後。
units.en: The director of ceremonial protocol led the tally-bearer to stand in front, with book-and-seal bearers on either side of the couches and the reading officers behind them.
units.literal: The director of ceremonial protocol led the tally-holder to stand in front; the officials who would lift and present the book and seal stood to the left and right of the book-and-seal couches; the book- and seal-reading officers each stood behind them.

units.zh: 宣徽使奏：「外辦。」
units.en: The Xuanhui Commissioner reported: "The outer preparations are complete."
units.literal: The Xuanhui Commissioner memorialized: "The outer preparations are complete."

units.zh: 內侍閣門官引後出後閣，宮縣作。
units.en: Inner attendants and Palace Gate officers led the empress from the rear pavilion as the palace ensemble played.
units.literal: The inner attendants and Palace Gate officers led the empress out from the rear pavilion; the palace bell-chime ensemble played.

units.zh: 簾卷，皇后降自西階，左右步障傘扇從，至階下，望勤政殿禦閣所在立，樂止。
units.en: The curtain was raised. The empress descended the western steps accompanied by portable screens, umbrellas, and ceremonial fans, and at the foot of the steps paused facing toward the imperial pavilion of the Qinzheng Hall as the music stopped.
units.literal: The curtain was rolled up; the empress descended by the western steps, with portable screens, umbrellas, and fans following on left and right; when she reached the foot of the steps she stood gazing toward where the imperial pavilion of the Qinzheng Hall was located; the music ceased.

units.zh: 冊使進，立于右，宣曰：「有制。」
units.en: The investiture envoy stepped forward, took position to the right, and declared: "There is an edict."
units.literal: The investiture envoy advanced, stood to the right, and announced: "There is an edict."

units.zh: 閣門使內侍贊：「再拜。」
units.en: The Palace Gate commissioner and inner attendants called: "Bow twice."
units.literal: The Palace Gate commissioner and inner attendants called out: "Bow twice."

units.zh: 冊使宣曰：「制遣太尉臣某、司徒臣某，恭授後冊寶。」
units.en: The investiture envoy proclaimed: "By imperial edict, Grand Commandant [name] and Minister of Education [name] reverently present the investiture book and seal to the empress."
units.literal: The investiture envoy announced: "By edict the Grand Commandant, your subject so-and-so, and the Minister of Education, your subject so-and-so, reverently confer upon the empress the book and seal."

units.zh: 閣門使內侍贊：「再拜。」
units.en: The Palace Gate commissioner and inner attendants called: "Bow twice."
units.literal: The Palace Gate commissioner and inner attendants called out: "Bow twice."

units.zh: 冊使少退。
units.en: The investiture envoy stepped back slightly.
units.literal: The investiture envoy withdrew slightly.

units.zh: 中書令、侍中及舉捧官率抬舁人奉冊寶以次進于前，宮縣作。
units.en: The Secretariat director, Palace Attendant, and presentation officers led the bearers forward with the book and seal in proper order as the palace ensemble played.
units.literal: The Director of the Secretariat, Palace Attendant, and presentation officials led the lifting and carrying personnel to present the book and seal in order before her; the palace bell-chime ensemble played.

units.zh: 冊寶床自東階升，並置於殿之前楹間，冊床在北，寶床在南，中留讀冊寶官立位，並去帕及蓋，抬舁人執之，退立於西朵殿。
units.en: The book-and-seal couches were carried up the eastern steps and set between the front pillars of the hall, the book couch to the north and the seal couch to the south, with space left between for the reading officers. The cloth covers and lids were removed and held by the bearers, who then withdrew to stand at the western side hall.
units.literal: The book-and-seal couches ascended by the eastern steps and were both placed between the front pillars of the hall; the book couch was to the north, the seal couch to the south; space was left in the middle for the book- and seal-reading officers to stand; the cloth covers and lids were all removed, and the lifting and carrying personnel held them and withdrew to stand at the western side hall.

units.zh: 舉抬官分左右相向立，讀冊寶官各立於床之東，西向，立既定，樂止。
units.en: The lifting officers divided to left and right and stood facing one another, while the reading officers took position east of the couches, facing west. Once all were in place, the music stopped.
units.literal: The lifting officers divided to left and right and stood facing one another; the book- and seal-reading officers each stood east of the couches, facing west; when they had stood in formation, the music ceased.

units.zh: 閣門使內侍贊：「再拜。」
units.en: The Palace Gate commissioner and inner attendants called: "Bow twice."
units.literal: The Palace Gate commissioner and inner attendants called out: "Bow twice."

units.zh: 捧謝表官以表授左立內侍，內侍以授後，受訖，以付右立內侍，內侍持表立於右。
units.en: The officer bearing the memorial of thanks handed it to the inner attendant on the left, who presented it to the empress. After she had received it, he passed it to the inner attendant on the right, who stood holding the memorial at the right.
units.literal: The official who would present the memorial of thanks handed the memorial to the inner attendant standing on the left; the inner attendant presented it to the empress; when she had received it, he handed it to the inner attendant standing on the right; the inner attendant held the memorial and stood on the right.

units.zh: 閣門使贊：「再拜。」
units.en: The Palace Gate commissioner called: "Bow twice."
units.literal: The Palace Gate commissioner called out: "Bow twice."

units.zh: 訖，冊使退，宮縣作。
units.en: When this was done, the investiture envoy withdrew as the palace ensemble played.
units.literal: When finished, the investiture envoy withdrew, and the palace bell-chime ensemble played.

units.zh: 持表內侍以表付閣門官，隨冊使行。
units.en: The inner attendant bearing the memorial handed it to a Palace Gate officer, who followed the investiture envoy in procession.
units.literal: The inner attendant holding the memorial handed the memorial to the Palace Gate officer, who followed the investiture envoy in procession.

units.zh: 冊使副至門，鼓吹振作如來儀，入西偏門，鼓吹止。
units.en: When the envoy and deputy reached the gate, the wind-and-percussion ensemble struck up as on the outward journey. They entered by the western side gate, where the music ceased.
units.literal: When the investiture envoy and deputy reached the gate, the wind-and-percussion band played vigorously as on the outward journey; they entered by the western side gate, and the wind-and-percussion music ceased.

units.zh: 冊使副至禦閣所在，俯伏，跪奏：「太尉臣某、司徒臣某，奉制授冊寶，禮畢。」
units.en: The envoy and deputy came to the imperial pavilion, prostrated themselves, and knelt to report: "Grand Commandant [name] and Minister of Education [name], by imperial command, have conferred the investiture book and seal. The rites are complete."
units.literal: The investiture envoy and deputy reached where the imperial pavilion was located, prostrated themselves, knelt and memorialized: "The Grand Commandant, your subject so-and-so, and the Minister of Education, your subject so-and-so, by edict conferred the book and seal; the ceremony is complete."

units.zh: 俯伏，興，退。
units.en: They prostrated themselves, rose, and withdrew.
units.literal: They prostrated themselves, rose, and withdrew.

units.zh: 持表閣門官進表，近侍接入，進讀，訖，退。
units.en: The Palace Gate officer bearing the memorial presented it; close attendants received it, brought it forward to be read aloud, and withdrew when finished.
units.literal: The Palace Gate officer holding the memorial advanced the memorial; the close attendants received it and brought it in, advanced it for reading, and when finished withdrew.

units.zh: 初，冊使退，及門樂止。
units.en: As the investiture envoy withdrew, the music stopped when he reached the gate.
units.literal: At first, when the investiture envoy withdrew, upon reaching the gate the music ceased.

units.zh: 閣門內侍引後自西階升殿，宮縣作。
units.en: Palace Gate officers and inner attendants led the empress up the western steps into the hall as the palace ensemble played.
units.literal: The Palace Gate officers and inner attendants led the empress to ascend the hall by the western steps; the palace bell-chime ensemble played.

units.zh: 傘扇止於簾外，退於左右朵殿前。
units.en: The umbrellas and ceremonial fans halted outside the curtain and withdrew to either side of the front halls.
units.literal: The umbrellas and fans stopped outside the curtain and withdrew to before the eastern and western side halls.

units.zh: 步障止於階下，卷之。
units.en: The portable screens halted at the foot of the steps and were rolled up.
units.literal: The portable screens stopped at the foot of the steps and were rolled up.

units.zh: 後於座前南向立，樂止。
units.en: The empress took her place before the throne facing south, and the music stopped.
units.literal: The empress stood facing south before the seat, and the music ceased.

units.zh: 中書令詣冊床南立，北向，稱：「中書令臣某，謹讀冊。」
units.en: The Director of the Secretariat stood south of the book couch, faced north, and declared: "Director of the Secretariat [name], your subject, respectfully reads the investiture book."
units.literal: The Director of the Secretariat went to stand south of the book couch, faced north, and announced: "The Director of the Secretariat, your subject so-and-so, respectfully reads the book."

units.zh: 讀畢，降自東階，立於欄外第一墀上，西向。
units.en: When he had finished reading, he descended the eastern steps and stood on the first terrace outside the railing, facing west.
units.literal: When the reading was finished, he descended by the eastern steps and stood on the first terrace outside the railing, facing west.

units.zh: 次侍中詣寶床南立，北向，揖稱：「侍中臣某，讀寶。」
units.en: Next the Palace Attendant stood south of the seal couch, faced north, bowed, and announced: "Palace Attendant [name], your subject, reads the seal."
units.literal: Next the Palace Attendant went to stand south of the seal couch, faced north, bowed with joined hands, and announced: "The Palace Attendant, your subject so-and-so, reads the seal."

units.zh: 讀畢降階，立于中書令之北，西向。
units.en: After reading he descended the steps and stood north of the Director of the Secretariat, facing west.
units.literal: When the reading was finished he descended the steps and stood north of the Director of the Secretariat, facing west.

units.zh: 內侍閣門引升座，宮縣作，坐定，樂止。
units.en: Inner attendants and Palace Gate officers led her to the throne as the palace ensemble played; once she was seated, the music stopped.
units.literal: The inner attendants and Palace Gate officers led her to ascend to the seat; the palace bell-chime ensemble played; when she was seated the music ceased.

units.zh: 舉捧官以次招抬舁人持帕蓋覆匣床，奉置殿之左右，冊床在東，寶床在西。
units.en: The presentation officers in turn directed the bearers to cover the cases and couches with cloth and lids and set them to the left and right of the hall, the book couch in the east and the seal couch in the west.
units.literal: The presentation officials in order summoned the lifting and carrying personnel to hold the cloth covers and lids and cover the cases and couches, and reverently placed them to the left and right of the hall; the book couch was in the east, the seal couch in the west.

units.zh: 置訖，舉捧官以次招抬降階，立于中書令、侍中之後，立定，合班北向，閣門贊：「再拜。」
units.en: Once everything was in place, the presentation officers directed the bearers down the steps to stand behind the Director of the Secretariat and Palace Attendant. When all were in formation they faced north together, and the Palace Gate office called: "Bow twice."
units.literal: When the placement was finished, the presentation officials in order summoned the lifting personnel to descend the steps and stand behind the Director of the Secretariat and Palace Attendant; when they had stood in formation they combined ranks facing north; the Palace Gate office called out: "Bow twice."

units.zh: 拜訖，降東階，退出殿門。
units.en: After bowing, they descended the eastern steps and left through the hall gate.
units.literal: When the bowing was finished, they descended the eastern steps and exited the hall gate.

units.zh: 其抬舁人置冊寶床於東西訖，各由朵殿下階，于侍中等班後直出殿門，以俟複入，抬舁入宮。
units.en: After setting the book-and-seal couches to east and west, each bearer descended by the side halls and went directly out the hall gate behind the Palace Attendant and others, to await re-entry, then carried the book and seal into the inner palace.
units.literal: When the lifting and carrying personnel had finished placing the book-and-seal couches to the east and west, each descended the steps by the side halls and went straight out the hall gate behind the formation of the Palace Attendant and others, to wait to re-enter; they lifted and carried them into the inner palace.

units.zh: 受冊表謝訖，內侍跪奏：「禮畢。」
units.en: After the investiture and memorial of thanks were concluded, an inner attendant knelt and reported: "The rites are complete."
units.literal: When the reception of the book and the memorial of thanks were finished, the inner attendant knelt and memorialized: "The ceremony is complete."

units.zh: 閣門引內外命婦陪列者以次進，就北向位。
units.en: Palace Gate officers led the inner and outer consorts in the accompanying ranks forward in order to their north-facing stations.
units.literal: The Palace Gate office led the inner and outer consorts in the accompanying formation to advance in order and take their north-facing positions.

units.zh: 班首初行，宮縣作，至位樂止。
units.en: As the lead rank moved forward, the palace ensemble played; music ceased when they reached their stations.
units.literal: When the head of the formation first set out, the palace bell-chime ensemble played; when they reached their positions the music ceased.

units.zh: 閣門曰：「再拜。」
units.en: The Palace Gate office called: "Bow twice."
units.literal: The Palace Gate office said: "Bow twice."

units.zh: 命婦皆再拜。
units.en: All consorts bowed twice.
units.literal: The consorts all bowed twice.

units.zh: 閣門引班首自西階升，樂作，至階樂止，進當座前，北向躬致稱賀，訖，降自西階，樂作，至位樂止。
units.en: The Palace Gate office led the lead consort up the western steps to music, which stopped at the steps. She advanced before the throne, faced north, bowed, and offered congratulations, then descended the western steps to music that ceased at her station.
units.literal: The Palace Gate office led the head of the formation to ascend by the western steps; music played; when they reached the steps the music ceased; they advanced before the seat, faced north, bowed the body, and offered congratulations; when finished they descended by the western steps; music played; when they reached their positions the music ceased.

units.zh: 閣門曰：「再拜。」
units.en: The Palace Gate office called: "Bow twice."
units.literal: The Palace Gate office said: "Bow twice."

units.zh: 舍人承傳，命婦等皆再拜。
units.en: The secretaries repeated the command, and all consorts bowed twice.
units.literal: The secretaries transmitted the command, and the consorts all bowed twice.

units.zh: 閣門使前承令，降自西階，詣命婦前西北，東向，稱：「有教旨。」
units.en: The Palace Gate commissioner came forward to receive the command, descended the western steps, went to the consorts' northwest position, faced east, and declared: "There is an edict of instruction."
units.literal: The Palace Gate commissioner advanced to receive the command, descended by the western steps, went to the northwest before the consorts, faced east, and announced: "There is an edict of instruction."

units.zh: 命婦等皆拜，閣門使宣曰：「祗奉聖恩，授以冊寶，榮幸之至，競厲增深。
units.en: All consorts bowed. The Palace Gate commissioner proclaimed: "In reverently receiving the imperial grace and the conferral of book and seal, the honor is beyond measure and our resolve is strengthened.
units.literal: The consorts all bowed; the Palace Gate commissioner proclaimed: "Reverently receiving the sage grace, conferred with the book and seal, the honor is supreme, and our diligence is redoubled.

units.zh: 所賀知。」
units.en: Your felicitations are acknowledged."
units.literal: Your congratulations are noted."

units.zh: 舍人曰：「再拜。」
units.en: The secretary called: "Bow twice."
units.literal: The secretary said: "Bow twice."

units.zh: 命婦皆再拜，訖，內侍引內命婦還宮。
units.en: All consorts bowed twice; when finished, inner attendants led the inner consorts back to the palace.
units.literal: The consorts all bowed twice; when finished the inner attendants led the inner consorts back to the palace.

units.zh: 班首初行，樂作，出門，樂止 。
units.en: As the lead rank departed, music played; it ceased when they passed through the gate.
units.literal: When the head of the formation first set out, music played; when they exited the gate the music ceased.

units.zh: 內侍引外命婦出次。
units.en: Inner attendants escorted the outer consorts out to their stations.
units.literal: The inner attendants led the outer consorts out to their stations.

units.zh: 宣徽使奏稱：「禮畢。」
units.en: The Xuanhui Commissioner reported: "The rites are complete."
units.literal: The Xuanhui Commissioner memorialized: "The ceremony is complete."

units.zh: 降座，宮縣作，入東房，樂止。
units.en: She left the throne as the palace ensemble played, entered the eastern chamber, and the music stopped.
units.literal: She descended from the seat; the palace bell-chime ensemble played; she entered the eastern chamber; the music ceased.

units.zh: 歸閣，宮縣作，至閣，樂止。
units.en: She returned to her pavilion to music from the palace ensemble, which ceased when she arrived.
units.literal: She returned to the pavilion; the palace bell-chime ensemble played; when she reached the pavilion the music ceased.

units.zh: 更常服。
units.en: She changed into ordinary dress.
units.literal: She changed into ordinary dress.

units.zh: 內侍承教旨，宣外命婦入會，並如常儀。
units.en: On the edict of instruction, inner attendants announced that the outer consorts should enter for the assembly, following the usual protocol.
units.literal: The inner attendants, receiving the edict of instruction, announced that the outer consorts should enter for the assembly, all according to regular protocol.

units.zh: 會畢，閣門引命外婦降階，橫班北向，舍人曰：「再拜。」
units.en: When the assembly ended, Palace Gate officers led the outer consorts down the steps into north-facing ranks; the secretary called: "Bow twice."
units.literal: When the assembly was finished, the Palace Gate office led the outer consorts down the steps; they formed ranks facing north; the secretary said: "Bow twice."

units.zh: 訖，以次出。
units.en: After bowing, they departed in order.
units.literal: When finished, they exited in order.

units.zh: 還宮，如來儀。
units.en: They returned to the palace by the same route as before.
units.literal: They returned to the palace as on the outward journey.

units.zh: 中書門下侍郎複以引進司帥抬舁人進冊寶入內，付與都點檢司，退。
units.en: The Vice Directors of the Secretariat and Chancellery again led the Introduction Office bearers to carry the book and seal into the inner palace, deliver them to the Directorate of Inspection, and withdraw.
units.literal: The Vice Directors of the Secretariat and Chancellery again led the Introduction Office to direct the lifting and carrying personnel to bring the book and seal into the inner palace, hand them over to the Directorate of Inspection, and withdraw.

units.zh: 別日，會群官，會妃主宗室等，賜酒，設食，簪花，教坊作樂，如內宴之儀。
units.en: On another day officials, consorts, princesses, and imperial clansmen were assembled; wine and food were bestowed, hair ornaments were conferred, and the Music Bureau performed, following the protocol for an inner court banquet.
units.literal: On a separate day they assembled the officials, assembled consorts, princesses, and imperial clansmen, bestowed wine, set out food, bestowed hair ornaments, and the Music Bureau performed, as in the protocol for an inner banquet.

units.zh: 十一日，朝永壽、永甯兩宮。
units.en: On the eleventh day the empress paid court at the Yongshou and Yongning palaces.
units.literal: On the eleventh day they attended court at the Yongshou and Yongning palaces.

units.zh: 皇后既受冊，越二日，內侍設座於所禦殿，南向。
units.en: Two days after the empress received investiture, inner attendants set up a seat in her residential hall, facing south.
units.literal: After the empress had received the investiture, two days later the inner attendants set up a seat in the hall where she resided, facing south.

units.zh: 其日夙興，宣徽使版奏：「中嚴。」
units.en: At dawn that day the Xuanhui Commissioner submitted on tablet: "We request that the inner court be secured."
units.literal: That day at dawn the Xuanhui Commissioner memorialized on tablet: "Request that the inner court be made strict."

units.zh: 質明，諸侍衛宮人俱詣寢殿奉迎，宣徽使版奏：「外辦。」
units.en: At dawn all guard attendants and palace women went to the sleeping hall to escort her; the Xuanhui Commissioner reported on tablet: "The outer preparations are complete."
units.literal: At dawn all the guard attendants and palace women went together to the sleeping hall to escort her in welcome; the Xuanhui Commissioner memorialized on tablet: "The outer preparations are complete."

units.zh: 後首飾禕衣禦車，內侍前導，降自西階以出，侍衛如常儀。
units.en: Wearing her ceremonial head ornaments and robes, the empress rode in the imperial carriage with inner attendants leading ahead; she descended the western steps to depart with the usual escort.
units.literal: The empress wore her head ornaments and ceremonial robes and rode in the imperial carriage; inner attendants went ahead as guides; she descended by the western steps to go out, with escort according to regular protocol.

units.zh: 至太后之裹門外，降車，障扇侍衛如常儀，入立於西廂，東向。
units.en: At the inner gate of the empress dowager's residence she alighted; screens and escort followed regular protocol; she entered and stood in the western wing, facing east.
units.literal: When she reached outside the inner gate of the empress dowager's residence she descended from the carriage; portable screens and guard escort were as in regular protocol; she entered and stood in the western wing, facing east.

units.zh: 將至，宣徽使版奏：「請中嚴。」
units.en: As she approached, the Xuanhui Commissioner submitted on tablet: "We request that the inner court be secured."
units.literal: As she was about to arrive, the Xuanhui Commissioner memorialized on tablet: "Request that the inner court be made strict."

units.zh: 既降車，宣徽使版奏：「外辦。」
units.en: After she had alighted, the Xuanhui Commissioner reported on tablet: "The outer preparations are complete."
units.literal: After she had descended from the carriage, the Xuanhui Commissioner memorialized on tablet: "The outer preparations are complete."

units.zh: 太后常服，宣徽使引升座，南向。
units.en: The empress dowager wore ordinary dress; the Xuanhui Commissioner led her to the throne, facing south.
units.literal: The empress dowager wore ordinary dress; the Xuanhui Commissioner led her to ascend to the seat, facing south.

units.zh: 宣徽使引後進，升自西階，北面再拜，進跪致謝詞。
units.en: The Xuanhui Commissioner led the empress forward; she ascended the western steps, bowed twice facing north, advanced, knelt, and offered words of thanks.
units.literal: The Xuanhui Commissioner led the empress to advance; she ascended by the western steps, faced north and bowed twice, advanced, knelt, and presented words of thanks.

units.zh: 存撫賜酒食，並如家人之儀。
units.en: Expressions of affection and the bestowal of wine and food followed the protocol used among family members.
units.literal: Expressions of care and bestowal of wine and food were all as in the protocol among family members.

units.zh: 禮畢，宣徽使贊：「再拜。」
units.en: When the rites were complete, the Xuanhui Commissioner called: "Bow twice."
units.literal: When the ceremony was finished, the Xuanhui Commissioner called out: "Bow twice."

units.zh: 訖。
units.en: When finished.
units.literal: When finished.

units.zh: 宣徽使引降自西階以出。
units.en: The Xuanhui Commissioner led her down the western steps and out.
units.literal: The Xuanhui Commissioner led her to descend by the western steps and go out.

units.zh: 出門，宣徽使奏：「禮畢。」
units.en: Outside the gate the Xuanhui Commissioner reported: "The rites are complete."
units.literal: Outside the gate the Xuanhui Commissioner memorialized: "The ceremony is complete."

units.zh: 降座入宮。
units.en: She left the throne and returned to the palace.
units.literal: She descended from the seat and entered the palace.

units.zh: 奉冊皇太后儀
units.en: Ceremony for Reverence to the Empress Dowager
units.literal: Ceremony for Reverence to the Empress Dowager

units.zh: 天德二年正月，詔有司：「擇日奉冊唐殷國妃、岐國太妃，仍別建宮名。
units.en: In the first month of Tiande 2, an edict ordered the relevant offices: "Choose a day to present the investiture book to Consort Tangyin of the Yin state and Grand Consort Qiguo, and establish separate palace names for each.
units.literal: In the first month of the second year of Tiande, an edict was issued to the relevant offices: "Select a day to reverently present the book to the Tangyin consort of the Yin state and the Qiguo grand consort, and additionally establish separate palace names.

units.zh: 合行典禮，禮官檢詳條具以聞。」
units.en: The ritual officers were to examine the applicable regulations in detail and submit a report."
units.literal: The ceremonies to be performed should be examined in detail by the ritual officers and reported."

units.zh: 其日質明，有司各具傘扇，侍衛如儀，及兵部約量差軍兵，並文武百官詣兩宮迎請，引導皇太后入內，並赴受冊殿，入禦幄，侍衛如式。
units.en: At dawn the responsible offices prepared umbrellas and fans and posted guards as prescribed; the Ministry of War assigned troops as needed; civil and military officials went to both palaces to escort the empress dowagers inside and on to the investiture hall, where they entered the imperial canopy pavilion with guard escort as prescribed.
units.literal: At dawn that day the relevant offices each prepared umbrellas and fans; guard escort was as in the protocol; the Ministry of War approximately assigned military troops; and civil and military officials all went to the two palaces to escort in welcome, led the empress dowagers into the inner palace, and all proceeded to the hall for receiving the book, entering the imperial canopy pavilion, with guard escort as prescribed.

units.zh: 次奉冊太尉等俱以冊置於案，奉寶司徒等俱以寶置於案，皆盛以匣，覆以帕，詣別殿門外幄次。
units.en: Next the Grand Commandants charged with the book set it on a table and the Ministers of Education charged with the seal set it on a table, each in a case covered with cloth, and proceeded to the canopy pavilion outside the separate hall gate.
units.literal: Next the Grand Commandants presenting the book each placed the book on a table, and the Ministers of Education presenting the seal each placed the seal on a table; all were placed in cases, covered with cloth, and went to the canopy pavilion outside the gate of the separate hall.

units.zh: 教坊提點率教坊入。
units.en: The Music Bureau superintendent led the musicians in.
units.literal: The Music Bureau superintendent led the Music Bureau personnel in.

units.zh: 侍衛官各就列。
units.en: Guard officers each took their assigned positions.
units.literal: The guard officers each took their formation positions.

units.zh: 皇帝常服乘輿，至別殿后幄次。
units.en: The emperor, in ordinary dress, rode in the palanquin to the rear canopy pavilion of the separate hall.
units.literal: The emperor in ordinary dress rode in the palanquin to the rear canopy pavilion of the separate hall.

units.zh: 通事舍人引宣徽使版奏：「中嚴。」
units.en: Protocol secretaries led the Xuanhui Commissioner to report on tablet: "The inner court is now secured."
units.literal: The protocol secretaries led the Xuanhui Commissioner to memorialize on tablet: "The inner court is made strict."

units.zh: 復位，少頃，又奏：「外辦。」
units.en: He returned to position; shortly afterward he reported again: "The outer preparations are complete."
units.literal: He returned to his position; after a short while he again memorialized: "The outer preparations are complete."

units.zh: 幄簾卷，教坊樂作，扇合，兩宮皇太后出自後幄，並即御座，南向，扇開，樂止。
units.en: The canopy curtain was raised, the Music Bureau played, and the fans closed. Both empress dowagers emerged from the rear canopy and took their thrones facing south; the fans opened and the music stopped.
units.literal: The canopy curtain was rolled up; the Music Bureau played; the fans closed; both empress dowagers came forth from the rear canopy and immediately took their imperial seats facing south; the fans opened and the music ceased.

units.zh: 分左右少退。
units.en: They withdrew slightly to left and right.
units.literal: They withdrew slightly to left and right.

units.zh: 通事舍人引文武百僚班左入，依品，重行西向，立定。
units.en: Protocol secretaries led the civil and military officials in from the left by rank in double rows facing west until all were in formation.
units.literal: The protocol secretaries led the civil and military hundred officials in formation from the left according to rank, in double rows facing west, and stood in formation.

units.zh: 通事舍人喝：「起居。」
units.en: The protocol secretaries called: "Inquire after well-being."
units.literal: The protocol secretaries called out: "Inquire after well-being."

units.zh: 班依常朝例起居，七拜，訖，引文武百僚班分東西相向立。
units.en: The formation followed the usual court protocol for greetings, with seven bows; when finished the secretaries led the officials into east-west formations facing one another.
units.literal: The formation followed the regular court assembly example for inquiring after well-being, seven bows; when finished the protocol secretaries led the civil and military hundred officials to divide into east-west formations facing one another.

units.zh: 通事舍人、太常博士贊引，太常卿前導，押冊官押冊而行，奉冊太尉、讀冊中書令、舉冊官等以次從之。
units.en: Protocol secretaries and Court of Imperial Sacrifices academicians directed the procession; the Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices went ahead as guide; book-escort officers led the book forward, followed in order by the Grand Commandant, Secretariat director, book-bearers, and others.
units.literal: The protocol secretaries and Court of Imperial Sacrifices academicians called out guidance; the Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices went ahead as guide; the officials escorting the book escorted the book in procession; the Grand Commandant presenting the book, Director of the Secretariat reading the book, book-presentation officials, and the like followed in order.

units.zh: 次押寶官押寶而行，奉寶司徒、讀寶侍中、舉寶官等以次從之。
units.en: Next seal-escort officers led the seal forward, followed in order by the Minister of Education, Palace Attendant, seal-bearers, and others.
units.literal: Next the officials escorting the seal escorted the seal in procession; the Minister of Education presenting the seal, Palace Attendant reading the seal, seal-presentation officials, and the like followed in order.

units.zh: 俱自正門入，教坊樂作，至殿庭西階下少東，北向，於褥位少置，樂止。
units.en: All entered through the main gate to Music Bureau accompaniment and paused briefly on the cushioned station slightly east of the western steps, facing north, where the music stopped.
units.literal: All entered by the main gate; the Music Bureau played; when they reached slightly east of the foot of the western steps of the hall courtyard, facing north, they briefly set them down on the cushioned position; the music ceased.

units.zh: 冊北，寶南。
units.en: The book stood to the north and the seal to the south.
units.literal: The book was to the north, the seal to the south.

units.zh: 通事舍人、太常博士贊引，太常卿前導，押冊官押冊升，樂作，奉冊太尉等從之，進至兩宮皇太后座前褥位，樂止。
units.en: Protocol secretaries and academicians directed the procession; the Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices led the way as book-escort officers carried the book up to music, followed by the Grand Commandant and others, advancing to the cushioned station before both empress dowagers, where the music stopped.
units.literal: The protocol secretaries and Court of Imperial Sacrifices academicians called out guidance; the Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices went ahead as guide; the officials escorting the book escorted the book up; music played; the Grand Commandant presenting the book and the others followed, advancing to the cushioned position before the seats of both empress dowagers; the music ceased.

units.zh: 兩宮冊寶齊上，齊讀。
units.en: The books and seals of both palaces were presented and read together.
units.literal: The books and seals of both palaces were presented together and read together.

units.zh: 舉冊官夾侍。
units.en: Book-bearers attended on either side.
units.literal: The book-presentation officials attended on either side.

units.zh: 奉冊太尉各搢笏，北向跪，俯伏，興，退立。
units.en: Each Grand Commandant tucked his tablet, knelt facing north, prostrated himself, rose, and withdrew to stand.
units.literal: Each Grand Commandant presenting the book tucked his tablet, knelt facing north, prostrated himself, rose, and withdrew to stand.

units.zh: 讀冊中書令俱進，向冊前跪奏稱：「攝中書令具官臣某，謹讀冊。」
units.en: All Secretariat directors advanced to the book, knelt, and reported: "Acting Director of the Secretariat, officer of record, your subject [name], respectfully reads the book."
units.literal: All Directors of the Secretariat reading the book advanced together, faced the book, knelt, and memorialized: "Acting Director of the Secretariat, officer of record, your subject so-and-so, respectfully reads the book."

units.zh: 舉冊官單跪對舉，中書令各搢笏，讀訖，執笏，俯伏，興，搢笏，捧冊興，於位東回冊函北向，並進，跪置於御座前褥位。
units.en: Book-bearers knelt on one knee and raised the book; each director tucked his tablet, finished reading, prostrated himself, rose, and with both hands raised the book, turned east at his station to face the case north, advanced together, knelt, and set it on the cushioned station before the throne.
units.literal: The book-presentation officials knelt on one knee and raised the book opposite them; each Director of the Secretariat tucked his tablet, finished reading, held his tablet, prostrated himself, rose, tucked his tablet, raised the book with both hands, turned east at his position to face the book case north, advanced together, knelt, and placed it on the cushioned position before the imperial seat.

units.zh: 中書令舉冊官俱降，還位。
units.en: The Secretariat directors and book-bearers all descended and returned to their stations.
units.literal: The Directors of the Secretariat and book-presentation officials all descended and returned to their positions.

units.zh: 奉冊太尉並降階，東向以俟。
units.en: The Grand Commandants all descended the steps and stood facing east to wait.
units.literal: The Grand Commandants presenting the book all descended the steps and stood facing east to wait.

units.zh: 押寶官押寶升，樂作，奉寶司徒等從之，進至兩宮皇太后座前褥位，樂止。
units.en: Seal-escort officers carried the seal up to music, followed by the Ministers of Education and others, advancing to the cushioned station before both empress dowagers, where the music stopped.
units.literal: The officials escorting the seal escorted the seal up; music played; the Ministers of Education presenting the seal and the others followed, advancing to the cushioned position before the seats of both empress dowagers; the music ceased.

units.zh: 舉寶官夾侍。
units.en: Seal-bearers attended on either side.
units.literal: The seal-presentation officials attended on either side.

units.zh: 奉寶司徒各搢笏，北向跪，俯伏，興，退立。
units.en: Each Minister of Education tucked his tablet, knelt facing north, prostrated himself, rose, and withdrew to stand.
units.literal: Each Minister of Education presenting the seal tucked his tablet, knelt facing north, prostrated himself, rose, and withdrew to stand.

units.zh: 讀寶侍中俱進，當寶前跪奏稱：「攝侍中具官臣某，謹讀寶。」
units.en: All Palace Attendants advanced to the seal, knelt, and reported: "Acting Palace Attendant, officer of record, your subject [name], respectfully reads the seal."
units.literal: All Palace Attendants reading the seal advanced together, faced the seal, knelt, and memorialized: "Acting Palace Attendant, officer of record, your subject so-and-so, respectfully reads the seal."

units.zh: 舉寶官單跪對舉，侍中各搢笏，讀訖，執笏，俯伏，興，搢笏，捧寶興，於位東回寶函北向，並進，跪置於御座前褥位冊之南。
units.en: Seal-bearers knelt on one knee and raised the seal; each Palace Attendant tucked his tablet, finished reading, prostrated himself, rose, and with both hands raised the seal, turned east at his station to face the case north, advanced together, knelt, and set it on the cushioned station before the throne, south of the book.
units.literal: The seal-presentation officials knelt on one knee and raised the seal opposite them; each Palace Attendant tucked his tablet, finished reading, held his tablet, prostrated himself, rose, tucked his tablet, raised the seal with both hands, turned east at his position to face the seal case north, advanced together, knelt, and placed it on the cushioned position before the imperial seat south of the book.

units.zh: 通事舍人、太常博士贊引太尉、司徒以次應行事官俱降自西階，複本班序立。
units.en: Protocol secretaries and academicians directed the Grand Commandant, Minister of Education, and other ritual officers to descend the western steps in order and return to their original stations.
units.literal: The protocol secretaries and Court of Imperial Sacrifices academicians called out guidance; the Grand Commandant, Minister of Education, and other ritual officers in order all descended by the western steps and returned to stand in their original formation order.

units.zh: 宣徽使一員詣皇帝禦幄前，俯伏，跪奏：「臣某謹請皇帝詣兩宮皇太后前，行稱賀之禮。」
units.en: A Xuanhui Commissioner went before the emperor's canopy pavilion, prostrated himself, knelt, and reported: "Your subject [name] respectfully requests that Your Majesty proceed before both empress dowagers to perform the congratulatory rites."
units.literal: One Xuanhui Commissioner went to before the emperor's imperial canopy pavilion, prostrated himself, knelt and memorialized: "Your subject so-and-so respectfully requests that the emperor go before both empress dowagers to perform the congratulatory rites."

units.zh: 俯伏，興。
units.en: He prostrated himself and rose.
units.literal: He prostrated himself and rose.

units.zh: 贊引皇帝再拜，又奏：「請北向跪。」
units.en: He guided the emperor to bow twice and again reported: "We request that Your Majesty kneel facing north."
units.literal: Guiding the emperor, he called for the emperor to bow twice, and again memorialized: "Request that Your Majesty kneel facing north."

units.zh: 皇帝賀曰：「嗣皇帝臣某言云云。」
units.en: The emperor offered congratulations, saying: "The succeeding emperor, your subject [name], states as follows."
units.literal: The emperor offered congratulations, saying: "The succeeding emperor, your subject so-and-so, states thus and so."

units.zh: 俯伏，興，又再拜，訖，又奏：「請皇帝少立。」
units.en: He prostrated himself, rose, and bowed twice again; when finished he reported again: "We request that Your Majesty stand briefly."
units.literal: He prostrated himself, rose, and again bowed twice; when finished he again memorialized: "Request that the emperor stand briefly."

units.zh: 內侍承旨退，西向稱：「兩宮皇太后旨云云。」
units.en: Inner attendants, receiving the command, withdrew and faced west, announcing: "The empress dowagers' edict states as follows."
units.literal: The inner attendants, receiving the command, withdrew and faced west, announcing: "The edict of both empress dowagers states thus and so."

units.zh: 皇帝再拜。
units.en: The emperor bowed twice.
units.literal: The emperor bowed twice.

units.zh: 宣徽使前引，皇帝歸幄，常服乘輿還內，侍衛如來儀。
units.en: The Xuanhui Commissioner led the way; the emperor returned to the canopy pavilion and rode in ordinary dress back to the inner palace with the same escort as before.
units.literal: The Xuanhui Commissioner went ahead as guide; the emperor returned to the canopy pavilion, rode in the palanquin in ordinary dress back to the inner palace, with guard escort as on the outward journey.

units.zh: 應階下文武百僚重行立定，通事舍人喝：「拜。」
units.en: Civil and military officials below the steps stood in double rows; protocol secretaries called: "Bow."
units.literal: The civil and military hundred officials below the steps stood in double rows in formation; the protocol secretaries called out: "Bow."

units.zh: 在位皆再拜。
units.en: All officials in position bowed twice.
units.literal: All those in position bowed twice.

units.zh: 通事舍人引太師詣西階升，俯伏，跪奏稱：「文武百僚具官臣某等稽首言，皇太后殿下顯對冊儀，永安帝養。
units.en: Protocol secretaries led the Grand Preceptor up the western steps to prostrate himself, kneel, and report: "The civil and military officials, officers of record, your subjects [names], bow the head and state: under the empress dowager's exalted reception of the investiture book, may the emperor's nurture be forever secure.
units.literal: The protocol secretaries led the Grand Preceptor to ascend the western steps, prostrate himself, kneel and memorialize: "The civil and military hundred officials, officers of record, your subjects so-and-so, bow the head and state: under the empress dowager's exalted reception of the book ceremony, may the emperor's nurture be forever secure.

units.zh: 仰祈福壽，與天同休。」
units.en: We pray that blessings and longevity may equal Heaven."
units.literal: We look up and pray for blessing and longevity equal to Heaven."

units.zh: 俯伏，興，降自西階，復位立定。
units.en: He prostrated himself, rose, descended the western steps, and returned to formation.
units.literal: He prostrated himself, rose, descended by the western steps, and returned to stand in formation.

units.zh: 通事舍人贊：「在位官皆再拜。」
units.en: Protocol secretaries called: "All officials in position, bow twice."
units.literal: The protocol secretaries called out: "All officials in position bow twice."

units.zh: 舞蹈，三稱「萬歲」，又再拜。
units.en: They performed the dance, thrice called "Ten thousand years," and bowed twice again.
units.literal: They performed the dance, thrice called "Ten thousand years," and again bowed twice.

units.zh: 宣徽使升自東階，取旨退，臨階西向稱：「兩宮皇太后旨。」
units.en: A Xuanhui Commissioner ascended the eastern steps, received the command, withdrew, and standing on the steps facing west announced: "The empress dowagers' edict."
units.literal: A Xuanhui Commissioner ascended by the eastern steps, received the command, withdrew, stood on the steps facing west, and announced: "The edict of both empress dowagers."

units.zh: 通事舍人贊：「在位官皆再拜。」
units.en: Protocol secretaries called: "All officials in position, bow twice."
units.literal: The protocol secretaries called out: "All officials in position bow twice."

units.zh: 畢，宣曰：「公等忠敬盡心，推崇協力。
units.en: When finished, they proclaimed: "You have all served with loyal devotion and united effort in this exaltation.
units.literal: When finished, they proclaimed: "You have all been loyal and reverent in heart, promoting and supporting with united effort.

units.zh: 膺茲令典，感愧良深。」
units.en: In receiving this splendid ceremony, our gratitude and humility are profound."
units.literal: Receiving this splendid ceremony, our sense of gratitude and shame is very deep."

units.zh: 宣訖，還位。
units.en: When the proclamation ended, they returned to their stations.
units.literal: When the proclamation was finished, they returned to their positions.

units.zh: 通事舍人贊：「謝宣諭，拜。」
units.en: Protocol secretaries called: "Thank the proclamation; bow."
units.literal: The protocol secretaries called out: "Thank the proclamation; bow."

units.zh: 在位官皆再拜，舞蹈，三稱「萬歲」，又再拜。
units.en: All officials bowed twice, performed the dance, thrice called "Ten thousand years," and bowed twice again.
units.literal: All officials in position bowed twice, performed the dance, thrice called "Ten thousand years," and again bowed twice.

units.zh: 通事舍人分引應北向官各分班東西立。
units.en: Protocol secretaries led the north-facing officials into separate east-west formations.
units.literal: The protocol secretaries in separate groups led the officials who should face north each to divide into east-west formations and stand.

units.zh: 宣徽使升自東階，奏稱：「具官臣等言，禮畢。」
units.en: A Xuanhui Commissioner ascended the eastern steps and reported: "We, officers of record, report that the rites are complete."
units.literal: The Xuanhui Commissioner ascended by the eastern steps and memorialized: "The officers of record, your subjects, state: the ceremony is complete."

units.zh: 降還位。
units.en: He descended and returned to his station.
units.literal: He descended and returned to his position.

units.zh: 扇合，皇太后並興，教坊樂作，降座，還殿后幄次，扇開，樂止。
units.en: The fans closed; both empress dowagers rose together to Music Bureau accompaniment, left their thrones for the rear canopy pavilion, and the fans opened as the music stopped.
units.literal: The fans closed; both empress dowagers rose together; the Music Bureau played; they descended from their seats and returned to the rear canopy pavilion behind the hall; the fans opened and the music ceased.

units.zh: 通事舍人引宣徽使奏：「解嚴。」
units.en: Protocol secretaries led the Xuanhui Commissioner to report: "The strict watch is lifted."
units.literal: The protocol secretaries led the Xuanhui Commissioner to memorialize: "The strict watch is lifted."

units.zh: 中書侍郎等各帥捧冊床官升殿，跪捧冊並置於床，次門下侍郎等各帥捧寶床官升殿，跪捧寶並置於床，訖，通事舍人引詣東上閣門，投進所司。
units.en: Vice Directors of the Secretariat led book-couch bearers up the hall to kneel and set the book on the couch; Vice Directors of the Chancellery led seal-couch bearers to do the same; when finished, protocol secretaries escorted them to the Eastern Upper Palace Gate office for delivery to the responsible office.
units.literal: Each Vice Director of the Secretariat led the officials bearing the book couch to ascend the hall, knelt and presented the book, and placed it on the couch; next each Vice Director of the Chancellery led the officials bearing the seal couch to ascend the hall, knelt and presented the seal, and placed it on the couch; when finished the protocol secretaries led them to the Eastern Upper Palace Gate office and submitted them to the responsible office.

units.zh: 文武百僚以次出。
units.en: Civil and military officials departed in order.
units.literal: The civil and military hundred officials exited in order.

units.zh: 皇太后常服乘輿，各還本宮，引導如來儀。
units.en: The empress dowagers, in ordinary dress, rode in palanquins back to their respective palaces with the same escort as before.
units.literal: The empress dowagers in ordinary dress rode in palanquins, each returning to her own palace, with escort as on the outward journey.

units.zh: 文武百僚詣東上閣門拜表賀皇帝，退。
units.en: Civil and military officials went to the Eastern Upper Palace Gate to submit congratulatory memorials to the emperor, then withdrew.
units.literal: The civil and military hundred officials went to the Eastern Upper Palace Gate office to submit memorials congratulating the emperor, then withdrew.

units.zh: 禮畢，各赴本宮，受內外命婦稱賀。
units.en: When the rites were complete, each went to his palace to receive congratulations from inner and outer consorts.
units.literal: When the ceremony was finished, each went to his own palace to receive congratulations from inner and outer consorts.

units.zh: 所司預於殿內設皇太后御座，司賓引內外命婦於殿庭北向依序立。
units.en: The responsible offices set the empress dowager's throne in the hall in advance; the Director of Guests led inner and outer consorts to stand in order in the courtyard, facing north.
units.literal: The relevant offices prepared in advance the empress dowager's imperial seat within the hall; the Director of Guests led inner and outer consorts to stand in the hall courtyard facing north in order.

units.zh: 尚儀奏請，皇太后常服即座。
units.en: The Director of Ceremonies requested her presence; the empress dowager in ordinary dress took the throne.
units.literal: The Director of Ceremonies memorialized the request; the empress dowager in ordinary dress took her seat.

units.zh: 司贊曰：「再拜。」
units.en: The master of announcements called: "Bow twice."
units.literal: The master of announcements said: "Bow twice."

units.zh: 命婦皆再拜。
units.en: All consorts bowed twice.
units.literal: The consorts all bowed twice.

units.zh: 司賓引班首詣西階升，跪賀稱：「妾某氏等言，伏惟皇太后殿下，天資聖善，昭受鴻名，凡在照臨，不勝欣抃。」
units.en: The Director of Guests led the lead consort up the western steps to kneel and offer congratulations: "Your subjects [names] state: before the empress dowager's exalted person, by Heaven-given sagely virtue she has received the great name; all within her illumination overflow with joy."
units.literal: The Director of Guests led the head of the formation to ascend the western steps, knelt, and offered congratulations, saying: "Your subjects of such-and-such clan and the like state: we bow before the empress dowager's exalted person; by Heaven-given sagely goodness she has received the great name; all within her illumination cannot contain their joy."

units.zh: 興，降階復位。
units.en: They rose, descended the steps, and returned to formation.
units.literal: They rose, descended the steps, and returned to their positions.

units.zh: 司贊曰：「再拜。」
units.en: The master of announcements called: "Bow twice."
units.literal: The master of announcements said: "Bow twice."

units.zh: 內外命婦皆再拜，尚宮承旨，降自西階，於命婦之北東向立，司贊曰：「再拜。」
units.en: Inner and outer consorts bowed twice; the Director of the Inner Palace received the command, descended the western steps, and stood north of the consorts facing east; the master of announcements called: "Bow twice."
units.literal: Inner and outer consorts all bowed twice; the Director of the Inner Palace received the command, descended by the western steps, and stood north of the consorts facing east; the master of announcements said: "Bow twice."

units.zh: 在位者皆再拜，尚宮乃宣答曰：「膺茲典禮，感愧良深。」
units.en: All in position bowed twice; the Director of the Inner Palace then proclaimed the reply: "In receiving this splendid ceremony, our gratitude and humility are profound."
units.literal: All those in position bowed twice; the Director of the Inner Palace then proclaimed the reply: "Receiving this splendid ceremony, our sense of gratitude and shame is very deep."

units.zh: 司贊曰：「再拜。」
units.en: The master of announcements called: "Bow twice."
units.literal: The master of announcements said: "Bow twice."

units.zh: 在位者皆再拜，退。
units.en: All in position bowed twice and withdrew.
units.literal: All those in position bowed twice and withdrew.

units.zh: 赴別殿賀皇帝，亦如賀皇太后之儀，惟不致詞，不宣答。
units.en: They proceeded to another hall to congratulate the emperor by the same protocol as for the empress dowager, except without formal speeches or a proclaimed reply.
units.literal: They proceeded to a separate hall to congratulate the emperor, also following the protocol for congratulating the empress dowager, except that they did not present formal words and no reply was proclaimed.

units.zh: 冊皇太子儀
units.en: Ceremony for Conferring the Title of Crown Prince
units.literal: Ceremony for Conferring the Title of Crown Prince

units.zh: 大定八年正月，冊皇太子，禮官擬奏，皇太子乘輿至翔龍門，東宮官導從，不乘馬。
units.en: In the first month of Dading 8, the crown prince was invested. Ritual officers drafted the protocol: the crown prince would ride in a palanquin to the Xianglong Gate, escorted by Eastern Palace officials on foot rather than on horseback.
units.literal: In the first month of the eighth year of Dading, the crown prince was invested; the ritual officers drafted a memorial; the crown prince would ride in a palanquin to the Xianglong Gate, with Eastern Palace officials as guides and escorts, not riding horses.

units.zh: 冊皇太子前三日，遣使同日奏告天地宗廟。
units.en: Three days before the investiture, envoys were dispatched the same day to report to Heaven, Earth, and the ancestral temples.
units.literal: Three days before conferring the title of crown prince, envoys were dispatched on the same day to announce to Heaven, Earth, and the ancestral temples.

units.zh: 冊前一日，宣徽院帥儀鸞司，設御座于大安殿當中，南向。
units.en: On the eve of the investiture, the Xuanhui Court directed the Ceremonial Escort Office to set the imperial seat in the center of the Da'an Hall, facing south.
units.literal: On the day before the investiture, the Xuanhui Court led the Ceremonial Escort Office to set up the imperial seat in the center of the Da'an Hall, facing south.

units.zh: 設皇太子次於門外之東，西向。
units.en: The crown prince's station was set outside the eastern gate, facing west.
units.literal: They set up the crown prince's station outside the gate to the east, facing west.

units.zh: 又設文武百僚應行事官，東宮官等次於門外之東、西廊。
units.en: Stations were also set in the eastern and western corridors outside the gate for civil and military officials, ritual officers, and Eastern Palace officials.
units.literal: They also set stations outside the gate in the eastern and western corridors for civil and military officials, ritual officers, Eastern Palace officials, and the like.

units.zh: 又設冊寶幄次於殿后東廂，俱南向。
units.en: Canopy pavilions for the book and seal were pitched in the eastern wing behind the hall, all facing south.
units.literal: They also set up book-and-seal canopy pavilions in the eastern wing behind the hall, all facing south.

units.zh: 又設受冊位於殿庭橫階之南。
units.en: A station for receiving the investiture was also marked south of the transverse steps in the courtyard.
units.literal: They also set the position for receiving the book south of the transverse steps in the hall courtyard.

units.zh: 工部官與監造冊寶官公服，自製造所導引冊寶床，由宣華門入，約宣徽院同進呈畢，赴幄次安置。
units.en: Ministry of Works officials and the book-and-seal manufacturing supervisors, in official dress, guided the presentation couches from the manufacturing office through the Xuanhua Gate, presented them jointly with the Xuanhui Court, and then set them down in the canopy pavilion.
units.literal: Officials of the Ministry of Works and the supervisors who had manufactured the book and seal, in official dress, guided the book-and-seal couches from the manufacturing office, entering by the Xuanhua Gate; they were to present them together with the Xuanhui Court and, when finished, proceed to the canopy pavilion to set them down.

units.zh: 大樂令帥其屬，展樂縣於庭。
units.en: The Director of Grand Music led his staff and set up the music ensemble in the courtyard.
units.literal: The Director of Grand Music led his subordinates and deployed the music ensemble in the courtyard.

units.zh: 其日，兵部帥其屬，設黃麾仗于大安殿門之內外。
units.en: That day the Ministry of War posted the yellow-banner guard formation inside and outside the Da'an Hall gates.
units.literal: On that day the Ministry of War led its subordinates and set up the yellow-banner guard formation inside and outside the gates of the Da'an Hall.

units.zh: 其日質明，文武百僚應行事官並朝服入次。
units.en: At dawn civil and military officials and ritual officers entered their stations in full court dress.
units.literal: At dawn that day the civil and military hundred officials and ritual officers all entered their stations in court dress.

units.zh: 東宮官各朝服，自東宮乘馬導從，至左翔龍門外下馬，入就次。
units.en: Eastern Palace officials in court dress rode from the Eastern Palace, dismounted outside the left Xianglong Gate, and entered their stations.
units.literal: Eastern Palace officials each in court dress rode horses from the Eastern Palace as guides and escorts, dismounted outside the left Xianglong Gate, and entered to take their stations.

units.zh: 通事舍人分引百官入立班，東西相向。
units.en: Protocol secretaries led the officials in to stand in east-west formation.
units.literal: The protocol secretaries in separate groups led the hundred officials in to stand in formation, facing east and west.

units.zh: 次引侍中、中書令、門下侍郎、中書侍郎及捧舁冊寶官，詣殿后幄次前立。
units.en: Next they led the Palace Attendant, Secretariat director, Chancellery and Secretariat vice directors, and book-and-seal bearers to stand before the canopy pavilion behind the hall.
units.literal: Next they led the Palace Attendant, Director of the Secretariat, Vice Director of the Chancellery, Vice Director of the Secretariat, and the officials who would lift and present the book and seal to stand before the canopy pavilion behind the hall.

units.zh: 少頃，奉冊寶出幄次，由大安殿東降，至庭中褥位，權置訖，奉引冊寶官立於其後。
units.en: Shortly afterward the book and seal were brought from the canopy pavilion, carried down the eastern side of the Da'an Hall to the cushioned station in the courtyard, set down temporarily, with presentation officers behind them.
units.literal: After a short while the book and seal were brought out from the canopy pavilion, descended by the eastern side of the Da'an Hall to the cushioned position in the courtyard, temporarily set down, and the officials presenting the book and seal stood behind them.

units.zh: 皇太子服遠遊冠、硃明衣出次，執圭，三師三少已下導從，立於門外。
